name: Lisa Shay
biography: is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at the US Military Academy at West Point. She is a Marshall Scholar with an M.Sc. from Cambridge University and a Ph.D. from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, both in Electrical Engineering. She is a Senior Member of the Institute of Electrical and Electronic Engineers. Her research interests include sensor systems and their implications on individual and societal privacy and freedom.
